grammar.q: Scott is tired ____ his job, so he decided to quit.
grammar.tip: be tired of 對…厭煩

grammar.q: John is really bored ____ playing the game with his brother.
grammar.tip: be bored with 對…感到無聊

grammar.q: Allie said she ____ me next weekend.
grammar.tip: said 過去式，子句未來用 would + V

grammar.q: This history book is ____. I've read it several times.
grammar.tip: 物令人有趣 → V-ing：interesting

grammar.q: I guess ____ the woman over there is Ian's mother. They look alike.
grammar.tip: I guess (that) 子句，that 可省略

grammar.q: Cindy feels ____ about the coming holiday. She has already made a plan for it.
grammar.tip: 人感到興奮 → excited about

grammar.q: The baby felt ____ and began to cry.
grammar.tip: 人感到害怕 → scared

grammar.q: We called Rita several times, but she didn't answer. Jerry and I guess ____ she left her smartphone at home again.
grammar.tip: guess that + 完整子句

grammar.q: My sister told me ____ to take a shower.
grammar.tip: told 過去式 → 子句用過去式 she wanted

grammar.q: It's a ____ day. I just want to lie on the couch and do nothing.
grammar.tip: 修飾事物「令人疲累的」→ tiring

grammar.q: Do you know ____ the man in the picture is very rich?
grammar.tip: know that + 完整子句

grammar.q: Jenny said she ____ the floor after dinner, but she forgot to do that.
grammar.tip: said 過去式，當時的未來 → would + V

grammar.q: The haunted house looks so ____. I will never go into it.
grammar.tip: 事物令人害怕 → scary

grammar.q: Taking care of kids is ____, and it takes patience.
grammar.tip: 動名詞主詞令人疲累 → tiring

grammar.q: Lina is ____ with eating the same food for lunch, so she'll try something new today.
grammar.tip: 人感到無聊 → be bored with

grammar.q: Henry was ____ about dating the girl of his dreams.
grammar.tip: 人感到興奮 → excited about

grammar.q: Nina felt surprised ____ her grade. She didn't study hard for the test, but she did well on it.
grammar.tip: be/feel surprised at 對…感到驚訝

grammar.q: My parents were very happy when they heard ____ my team won the baseball game.
grammar.tip: heard that + 完整子句

grammar.q: Lydia is ____ to find that her two-year-old son is able to count from one to ten.
grammar.tip: 人感到驚訝 → surprised to V

grammar.q: My father said that it ____ rainy the next day.
grammar.tip: said 過去式＋隔天 → would be

grammar.q: I can't believe ____ Karen ____ angry with me. I will never talk to her again.
grammar.tip: believe that + 主詞 + 動詞

grammar.q: Mary thinks ____ the show is ____. So, she doesn't want to come with us.
grammar.tip: that 可省略；節目令人無聊 → boring

grammar.q:
A: Do you mind ____ the window for me? It's hot here.
B: No problem.
grammar.tip: mind + V-ing

grammar.q: That man is ____. No one is ____ in talking to him.
grammar.tip: 令人無聊 boring；感興趣 interested in

grammar.q: Sandy is scared ____ ghosts, so she ____ never watched any horror movies.
grammar.tip: be scared of；never 用現在完成式

grammar.q: Jack thought ____ his mom was happy because he sent her a gift.
grammar.tip: thought that + 完整子句

grammar.q: Sam told us he ____ turn off the fan later, but he didn't.
grammar.tip: told 過去式 → would + V

grammar.q: Olivia is tired of ____ food delivery every day. She has planned to try cooking tonight.
grammar.tip: 介系詞 of 後接 V-ing

grammar.q: My mom said ____ she was tired and needed a break.
grammar.tip: said (that) 子句，that 可省略

grammar.q: Going rock climbing sounds ____. We are ____ about it.
grammar.tip: 事 exciting；人 excited about

grammar.q: All my family were surprised ____ the bad news.
grammar.tip: be surprised at + 事物

grammar.q: Patty told me ____ this book was very interesting.
grammar.tip: told me that + 完整子句

grammar.q:
A: Let's watch A Quiet Place.
B: No, the movie is too ____. I won't be able to sleep if I watch it.
grammar.tip: 電影令人害怕 → scary

grammar.q:
A: The baseball game last night was ____.
B: Yeah. The Lion team won the game in the last minute.
grammar.tip: 比賽令人興奮 → exciting

grammar.q: Mr. Chang said ____ his wife was the most important person in his life.
grammar.tip: said that + 完整子句

grammar.q:
A: Why are you going to change the light bulb? It still works well.
B: Because it's not bright enough. My eyes ____ easily when I read.
grammar.tip: 眼睛感到疲累 → get tired

grammar.q:
A: Does he know ____ come back from Japan?
B: I don't think so.
grammar.tip: 名詞子句用直述句語序：we have

grammar.q: Mopping the floor is really tiring ____ me.
grammar.tip: 事物 + be tiring to + 人

grammar.q: The kids are ____ with the movie. It's ____ to them.
grammar.tip: 人 bored with；電影 boring to 人

grammar.q: Do you mind ____ the door for me? My hands are full.
grammar.tip: mind + V-ing

fix.t: Josh [[has planned]] to make a trip to New York next month and [[visiting]] some of his friends [[there]].
fix.tip: and 連接 to make 與 (to) visit，須用原形 visit

fix.t: [[Taking]] a map [[with you]] when you go to a place [[for the first time]].
fix.tip: 句子缺主要動詞，這是祈使句，須用原形 Take 開頭

fix.t: My cat [[got excited]] when it [[saw]] the boy [[to catch]] the birds.
fix.tip: see + 人 + V-ing（正在做），不用 to V

fix.t: People got very [[excited]] when [[they]] watched Ms. Smith [[danced]] at the party.
fix.tip: watch + 人 + V-ing/原形，不用過去式 danced

fix.t: Cindy enjoys [[listen to]] her dad [[read]] stories [[to her]] before bed.
fix.tip: enjoy + V-ing；listen to 人 + 原形 read 正確

fix.t: Jo won't be happy if [[you're]] late for his party tonight, so [[to make]] sure that you [[arrive]] on time.
fix.tip: so 後是祈使句，用原形 make

fix.t: If you're [[interested in]] our business plan, [[to call]] this number and [[ask for]] Ms. Lee. She'll answer your questions.
fix.tip: 主要子句是祈使句，用原形 call 開頭

fix.t: Although it [[took]] me lots of time [[prepared]] a big meal for ten people, I was happy [[that]] everyone enjoyed it.
fix.tip: It takes + 人 + 時間 + to V

fix.t: Our school basketball team [[won]] the national game [[last night]]. We are so [[popular with]] them.
fix.tip: 球隊贏了，我們以他們為傲 → be proud of

fix.t: Jill is [[excited]] that the city park [[is closed]] for the music festival because now she [[can't jog]] there.
fix.tip: 不能去慢跑，應該是不開心 unhappy

fix.t: The movie was [[so long]] that many people [[fell asleep]]. Even my dad felt [[boring]] and left early.
fix.tip: 人「感到」無聊用 bored；boring 是令人無聊

fix.t: Kevin was [[surprising]] at the news [[that]] his best friend [[was moving]] to Japan.
fix.tip: 人感到驚訝 → be surprised at

fix.t: Mom [[said]] that she [[will cook]] beef noodles for us [[that night]], but she was too tired.
fix.tip: said 過去式，子句的未來要用 would + V

fix.t: Until I met him [[yesterday]], I didn't know [[what]] Amy [[had]] a little brother.
fix.tip: know 後接完整子句用 that，what 須缺主詞或受詞

fix.t: After [[climbing]] the mountain for five hours, we were all very [[hungry]] and [[tiring]].
fix.tip: 人感到疲累 → tired；tiring 是令人疲累

fix.t: Since he [[was]] a child, Tom [[has been]] interested [[on]] science.
fix.tip: be interested in 對…有興趣

fix.t: Ken is scared [[with]] big dogs, so he always [[walks]] on the other side of the street when he [[sees]] one.
fix.tip: be scared of 害怕…

fix.t: Do you mind [[to turn]] down the music? I [[am trying]] to study for [[tomorrow's]] test.
fix.tip: mind 後接動名詞：mind + V-ing

fix.t: My brother [[thinks]] that horror movies are [[excited]], but I [[get]] scared when I watch them.
fix.tip: 電影「令人」興奮 → exciting

fix.t: Lisa told me she [[is]] busy yesterday, so she [[couldn't]] come to my party [[on time]].
fix.tip: told 過去式＋yesterday → 子句用過去式 was

fix.t: The news was [[surprised]] to everyone, so people [[talked]] about it [[all day]].
fix.tip: 事物令人驚訝 → be surprising to 人

fix.t: All the students [[listen]] to Mr. Wang [[carefully]] because his history class is [[interested]].
fix.tip: 課程「令人」有趣 → interesting

fix.t: Our teacher [[told]] us [[what]] the earth [[goes]] around the sun.
fix.tip: 子句完整用 that；不變的事實仍用現在式 goes

fix.t: Last week I thought Ben [[can]] fix my computer, but he [[didn't]] even know how [[to turn]] it on.
fix.tip: thought 過去式，子句助動詞改過去式 could

fix.t: The kids [[were]] so [[exciting]] about the trip that they [[couldn't]] sleep last night.
fix.tip: 人感到興奮 → be excited about

fix.t: We heard that Mr. Lin [[gets]] married last month, and we [[were]] all happy [[for]] him.
fix.tip: last month 是過去時間，用過去式 got
